<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="the-fight-kiln" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>The Fight Kiln</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/n4B2Z2KLAw.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Fight_Kiln <nowiki>Fight Kiln</nowiki>]<nowiki> is a wave-based encounter which requires completion of </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_Elder_Kiln <nowiki>The Elder Kiln</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest and a one-time sacrifice of a fire cape. There are 37 waves which become increasingly difficult as the fight progresses.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Completing the fight rewards you with a cape for your most used style </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153768065427853354.png?v=1" alt="kilnmage" title="kilnmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602582045553590274.png?v=1" alt="KilnMelee" title="KilnMelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772314215858247.png?v=1" alt="kilnnecro" title="kilnnecro" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/602582045541269567.png?v=1" alt="KilnRanged" title="KilnRanged" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Each cape can be used to craft its respective igneous variant </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1153772938252787793.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalmej" title="igneouskalmej" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404192316.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalket" title="igneouskalket" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139200072438005851.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalmor" title="igneouskalmor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626404171786.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalxil" title="igneouskalxil" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ These are combined into the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/902209626479685734.png?v=1" alt="igneouskalzuk" title="igneouskalzuk" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="general-wave-breakdown"><nowiki>General Wave Breakdown</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 1-9 are mostly weak to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="Attack" title="Attack" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 11-19 are mostly weak to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 21-29 are mostly weak to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 31 is weak to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250472476758.png?v=1" alt="Attack" title="Attack" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 32 is weak to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 33 is weak to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="preset-suggestions"><ins><nowiki>Preset Suggestions</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=AToCog7o6tN7tyjnbfpN <nowiki>All styles</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2FAToCog7o6tN7tyjnbfpN.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Gear and inventory can get switched around based on what you have and how experienced you are</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• As long as you have a pickaxe in your toolbelt, you will be able to kill Dills using your Melee weapon</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Obsidian armour reduces damage taken in the Fight Kiln and saves inventory space if not bringing switches</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tri-bridding is the best way to deal with the Fight Kiln. At the minimum, you want a 2H weapon of every style</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975012160759550042.png?v=1" alt="tokkulzo" title="tokkulzo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> provides a 10% damage boost against the mobs but requires tokkul to upkeep</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bring a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065877831680.png?v=1" alt="rov" title="rov" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if the passive version is not unlocked</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="the-fight"><ins><nowiki>The Fight</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="waves-1-9"><nowiki>Waves 1-9</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>There will be mostly rangers with an increasing number of magers and meleers so use Melee and switch to kill the others</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wave 2</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Invulnerability crystal spawn</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wave 4</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Restoration crystal spawn</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wave 5</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Dill spawn</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wave 9</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: All rangers</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on the last ranger to have it for Jad</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="wave-10"><nowiki>Wave 10</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/cibB2kx.jpg" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Jad</nowiki></strong><nowiki> spawns </nowiki><strong><nowiki>southwest</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 1 ranger also spawns southeast</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="wave-11-19"><nowiki>Wave 11-19</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>There will mostly be magers with an increasing number of meleers and rangers so use Ranged and switch to kill the others</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wave 14</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Invulnerability crystal spawn</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wave 16</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Restoration crystal spawn</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wave 19</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Dill spawn (switch to Melee for Dill)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Go northeast, kill the Dill then go southwest and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> killing all the magers, use remainder on Jad</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="wave-20"><nowiki>Wave 20</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Jad</nowiki></strong><nowiki> spawns </nowiki><strong><nowiki>southwest</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 1 mager also spawns southeast</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="waves-21-29"><nowiki>Waves 21-29</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>There will mostly be meleers with an increasing number of magers and rangers so use Magic and switch to kill the others</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wave 26</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Invulnerability crystal spawn</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wave 28</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Restoration crystal spawn</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wave 28</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: 6 Dills spawn with a mager (kill mager then swap to Melee)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wave 29</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and kill meleers, use remainder on Jad</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="wave-30"><nowiki>Wave 30</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Jad</nowiki></strong><nowiki> spawns </nowiki><strong><nowiki>southwest</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 3 meleers spawn in other corners</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="waves-31-33"><nowiki>Waves 31-33</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wave 31</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Use Melee</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wave 32</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Use Magic</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Wave 33</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Use Ranged</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="wave-34"><nowiki>Wave 34</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Jad</nowiki></strong><nowiki> spawns </nowiki><strong><nowiki>southeast</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 1 meleer spawns northwest, and one ranger southwest</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="wave-35"><nowiki>Wave 35</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Jad</nowiki></strong><nowiki> spawns </nowiki><strong><nowiki>northeast</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ 1 meleer spawns northwest, 1 ranger southwest, and 1 mager southeast</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="wave-36"><nowiki>Wave 36</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/hLsQnEw.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Double Jads</nowiki></strong><nowiki> spawn in </nowiki><strong><nowiki>both southern corners</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use invulnerability crystals here</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="wave-37-har-aken"><nowiki>Wave 37 (Har-Aken)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/n4B2Z2KLAw.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
⬥ Spawns tentacles that deal Magic or Ranged hits. Build/heal on these when he is not on the surface</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ He never spawns on northern side of the platform</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Spawns after ~72 seconds and is up for ~30 seconds</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921595489488927.png?v=1" alt="sunshinepf" title="sunshinepf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="zerk" title="zerk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1" alt="livingdeath" title="livingdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994921597813137518.png?v=1" alt="deathsswiftpf" title="deathsswiftpf" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as he surfaces</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Apply </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1" alt="Vuln" title="Vuln" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Spam </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/651079281882955787.png?v=1" alt="spiritualprayer" title="spiritualprayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1" alt="ripperpouch" title="ripperpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275155464203.png?v=1" alt="ripperscroll" title="ripperscroll" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="tips-and-tricks"><ins><nowiki>Tips and Tricks</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="general"><nowiki>General</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ You can use restoration crystals in emergencies and to extend </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159085207555.png?v=1" alt="onsl" title="onsl" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on Har-Aken if needed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Make sure you have </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005552211847295076.png?v=1" alt="signoflife" title="signoflife" kind="icon" /><nowiki> up just in case because the hits start to add up very quickly</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for the majority of the fight and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="deflectrange" title="deflectrange" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as needed, don't forget </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• On wave 19 there are a lot of magers so using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can help</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Always use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="deflectrange" title="deflectrange" kind="icon" /><nowiki> when fighting Jads</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Invulnerability crystals do not protect you from Dill special attacks, instead use restoration crystals</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
